observations: A clean blinded protocol can still produce a valid mechanical FAIL and useful diagnostic evidence; protocol integrity and task success are separate axes.
Public instructions and deterministic invariant scorers need one typed concept vocabulary to avoid lexical false negatives without relaxing fail-closed behavior.
Historical trial immutability requires repairing the generator/scorer contract only for future suites and requiring a new response.
proposed_change: Add a typed invariant concept contract shared by public task wording and scoring, with regressions for aligned concepts, omitted concepts, and historical-artifact immutability.
